g.title: ConversationalBrain
g.text: Conversational brain — the production pipeline + the region inventory
the production conversation (OneBrainComposer) — comprehend → bind into a fact → recall & answer (with the no-confabulation safeguard) → reply
the underlying region inventory built by build_biological_brain_regions() (a reference) · concept pools collapsed ×4 names · signal nature + learning shown

g.title: cluster_pipeline
g.text: · the pipeline that actually runs (OneBrainComposer, on the shared "one brain")

g.title: pp_in
g.text: a sentence (e.g. "the dog eats a big apple")

g.title: pp_cortex
g.text: hears words in context, picks up their meaning · similar words end up close together

g.title: pp_parse
g.text: same answer for "dog chases cat" / "cat is chased by dog" (voice-invariant)
flexible word orders, auto-detected (subject-verb-object · verb-subject-object · object-subject-verb)

g.title: pp_bind
g.text: Composer — bind the words into a fact
attributed objects ("big apple") · negation / yes-no · embedded clauses ·
⚠ the binding rule is fixed algebra — a stand-in for a learned cortex (the open "step 3")

g.title: pp_store
g.text: each fact = a pattern written into complex synapses

g.title: pp_recall
g.text: who / what · yes-no & negation · multi-hop reasoning · multi-turn dialogue
answers "I don't know" rather than inventing
(reconstruct a stored fact, unbind the roles, clean up, match the question's cue)

g.title: pp_dlg
g.text: picks the next on-topic thing to say

g.title: pp_out
g.text: a spiking "say-this-first" ranking orders the words
competitive-queuing serial order (not a fixed host template)

g.title: leg
g.text: = the PRODUCTION conversation that actually runs (parser → composer → recall & answer → reply)
= the underlying region inventory of build_biological_brain_regions() — a reference map; not all of it is on the production path
= the answer step says "I don't know" instead of guessing (a learned familiarity check)
fast inhibition — "fire less" (a pool suppresses its rivals, GABA-A)
self-sustaining loop ⟲ / memory consolidation into cortex (during "sleep")
dashed border = optional (flag-gated) · dashed arrow = weaker / feedback
a pathway that is WIRED but did NOT work (a negative / boundary result), kept for honesty —
NOT a working capability (the earlier verb→motor composition attempts)
drawn once, stands for several copies (×4 names per kind; ×N pools)
input/output boundary (words in / words out) = LEGITIMATE, not a shortcut
a documented SHORTCUT (a simplified stand-in, or a step still done by host maths). Simplifications SH-1…SH-14 are in the spec.
